blocks.text: When fashion icon Maria Beatriz “Patis” Tesoro was recently proclaimed National Artist for Design, Filipino-American visual artist Loisse Ledres was instantly elated by the news. The Grand Dame of Philippine Fashion, after all, was Ledres’ No.1 influence in her multifaceted approach towards the arts. But most of all, the Cebu City-born multimedia creative was drawn to Tesoro uncompromising stance to being limitless across all her platforms. “She (Tesoro) is not limited by just one medium. She’s a very strong cultural figure,” the 28-year-old New York City resident said. READ: Solenn Heussaff pays tribute to dementia-stricken dad in latest artwork Tesoro is […]...
